verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a cloud GPU and ML platform that hosts user data, so whether customer data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no policy, setting or opt-out about training on customer data. The docs cover only machines, storage, API keys and access controls, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
